name: Route 111
lines:
I watered the plants every day.
They grew lots of flowers.
And they gave me lots of Berries, too.
Here you go!
You can have one!

I’m going to work harder
and grow more flowers!
I hope you do, too!

I’m going to work harder
and grow more flowers!
I hope you do, too!

Next time, I’m going to grow
red flowers—blazing red flowers.

Old Lady’s Rest Stop
Come in and rest your tired bones.
